standards.name: CIDOC Conceptual Reference Model (CIDOC CRM)
standards.scope: Upper-level ontology for cultural heritage entities and relationships.
mandatory_usage: Map every Pleroma entity class, property, and relationship to a recognized ontology.
Use CRM classes and properties as the semantic backbone for cultural-heritage data.
implementation_contract: Maintain mappings in schema and ontology documentation.
Document unmapped concepts and propose project SKOS concepts or formal ontology extensions.

standards.name: CIDOC CRM Archaeological Excavation Model (CRMarchaeo)
standards.version: As adopted by the project ontology
standards.scope: Archaeological stratigraphy, excavation sequences, and excavation activities.
mandatory_usage: Model stratigraphic units and archaeological excavation relationships using the extension.
Represent stratigraphic units as relational entities, not parent-record free text.
implementation_contract: Use A2 Stratigraphic Volume Unit and the applicable containment relationships described in the project ontology.

standards.name: CIDOC CRM Scientific Observation Model (CRMsci)
standards.version: As adopted by the project ontology
standards.scope: Scientific sampling, observations, and resulting data.
mandatory_usage: Represent laboratory sampling and material-analysis observations using the scientific extension.
implementation_contract: Use S2 Sample, S4 Observation, and S6 Data Object where applicable.

standards.name: CIDOC CRM Geospatial Model (CRMgeo)
standards.version: As adopted by the project ontology
mandatory_usage: Use the extension for rigorous 4D spatiotemporal representation.
implementation_contract: Map geospatial entities and temporal extents to the project ontology's CRMgeo profile.

standards.name: CIDOC CRM Argumentation Model (CRMinf)
standards.version: As adopted by the project ontology
standards.scope: Hypotheses, propositions, arguments, and belief formation.
mandatory_usage: Represent interpretation hypotheses separately from observed or material evidence.
implementation_contract: Use I1 Argumentation and I4 Proposition Set where applicable.
Retain certainty and evidence links with the interpretation.

standards.name: FRBR Object-Oriented (FRBRoo)
standards.version: As adopted by the project ontology
mandatory_usage: Use for bibliographic and manuscript entities where relevant, including Text_Witness modeling.
implementation_contract: Map manuscript and bibliographic entities to documented FRBRoo classes, including F4 Manifestation Singleton where applicable.

standards.name: Getty Art & Architecture Thesaurus (AAT)
mandatory_usage: Use Getty AAT terms for Object_Type fields on Find and Feature records.
implementation_contract: Store controlled terms as SKOS concepts and map applicable concepts to AAT identifiers.

standards.name: GBIF Backbone Taxonomy
standards.version: Current adopted release to be recorded during implementation
mandatory_usage: Use for Flora_Specimen and Fauna_Specimen species identifications.
implementation_contract: Record the GBIF taxon identifier and retain reconciliation provenance.

standards.name: Glottolog
standards.version: Current adopted release to be recorded during implementation
standards.authority: Max Planck Institute for Evolutionary Anthropology
mandatory_usage: Use Glottolog identifiers for Language_Family and Linguistic_Zone classifications.
implementation_contract: Store the Glottolog code with the classification and retain reconciliation provenance.

standards.name: Aarne-Thompson-Uther Index and Thompson Motif-Index
standards.version: Applicable editions to be recorded during implementation
standards.authority: International Society for Folk Narrative Research
mandatory_usage: Use for Religious_Element and Oral_Tradition motif assignments.
implementation_contract: Represent assignments as controlled concepts and preserve source/index identifiers.

standards.name: Extended Date/Time Format (EDTF)
standards.scope: Machine-readable dates, ranges, and temporal uncertainty.
mandatory_usage: Use EDTF for every canonical date and time-span field.
Reject free-text dates in canonical date fields.
implementation_contract: Validate EDTF on write.
Preserve uncertainty and approximation markers rather than normalizing them away.
Keep period names and explanatory date prose in notes, alongside a canonical EDTF value.

standards.name: Zotero bibliographic integration and DOI identifiers
standards.authority: Corporation for Digital Scholarship / DOI registration agencies
mandatory_usage: Link Bibliographic_Reference records to the Zotero group library using Zotero_Key.
Record a DOI for journal articles, excavation reports, and dataset references when one exists.
implementation_contract: Synchronize the Zotero cache and detect duplicates by DOI where available.

standards.name: OGC Simple Features and ISO 19107
standards.version: Applicable profile to be recorded during implementation
standards.scope: Geometry storage, validation, and geospatial publication.
mandatory_usage: Use standards-compliant geometries for spatial data.
Publish geospatial layers through OGC-compliant WMS and WFS.
implementation_contract: Validate geometry topology and coordinate reference systems before accepting writes.

standards.name: IIIF Presentation API and Image API
standards.scope: Media presentation, image delivery, and annotations.
mandatory_usage: Deliver media assets through IIIF; direct local-image hosting is prohibited.
implementation_contract: Use Cantaloupe for IIIF image delivery.
Store manifest and image-service URIs with media metadata.
Version annotation edits rather than overwriting prior states.

standards.name: RDF 1.1 Turtle and JSON-LD
standards.scope: Triple-store export and Linked Open Data publication.
mandatory_usage: Use Turtle or JSON-LD for triple-store exports and Linked Open Data publication.
implementation_contract: Document serialization context, namespaces, and mapping rules for each published dataset.

standards.name: Simple Knowledge Organization System (SKOS)
standards.scope: Controlled vocabularies, concept schemes, and hierarchical terms.
mandatory_usage: Represent enumerated categories and controlled vocabularies as SKOS concept schemes.
implementation_contract: Mirror vocabulary concepts in the triple store and PostgreSQL lookup tables.
Use skos:broader, skos:narrower, and skos:related for concept relations.
Use skos:exactMatch, skos:closeMatch, or skos:broadMatch for external mappings.
Use persistent Pleroma vocabulary URIs and govern new terms through review.
